definitions.bipartisan: Sponsored bill with at least one original cosponsor from the other caucus; withdrawn cosponsorships excluded.
definitions.caucus: Independents counted with the party they caucus with; party evaluated as of the sponsorship date.
definitions.rankedTypes: Bills and joint resolutions only (HR, S, HJRES, SJRES). Simple and concurrent resolutions appear on member pages but are not ranked.
definitions.stageCounts: Cumulative: a bill that became law also counts in passed and reported.
definitions.summaries: Congressional Research Service summaries are shown where they exist. Where they do not, a summary generated by Claude (Anthropic) from the bill text is shown and labelled as such.
